state.output:
name: OpenCode

# OpenCode serve + a mobile chat on a GitHub runner, published through a
# cloudflared quick tunnel. Official web UI is too heavy for a phone.
#
# Why a separate workflow: the Zen agent is this fork's own loop. OpenCode is
# a different product with its own models, tools and web client. Users pick
# linux or windows the same way they do for the agent.

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      os:
        description: "Runner OS"
        type: choice
        options: [linux, windows]
        default: linux
      ui:
        description: "Web interface: original SPA (web) or lightweight mobile chat (mobile)"
        type: choice
        options: [web, mobile]
        default: web
      prompt:
        description: "Optional first prompt, sent once the web UI is up"
        type: string
        default: ""
      branch:
        description: "Working branch (created if absent)"
        type: string
        default: "opencode-work"
      runner_linux:
        description: "Runner for the Linux job (a label, or self-hosted - see pc-local/runner)"
        type: string
        default: "ubuntu-latest"
      runner_windows:
        description: "Runner for the Windows job (a label, or self-hosted - see pc-local/runner)"
        type: string
        default: "windows-latest"

concurrency:
  group: zen-panel-session-${{ github.repository }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  HUB_LOGS: /home/runner/.npm-hub/logs

jobs:
  opencode-linux:
    if: inputs.os == 'linux'
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner_linux }}
    timeout-minutes: 360

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: fork
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'

      - name: Prepare the working branch
        working-directory: fork
        run: |
          git config user.email "opencode@zen-panel"
          git config user.name  "OpenCode"
          BRANCH="${{ inputs.branch }}"
          if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$BRANCH" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            git branch -f "$BRANCH" HEAD
            git checkout -q "$BRANCH"
            git push -q --force-with-lease origin "$BRANCH" || git push -q -f origin "$BRANCH"
          else
            git checkout -q -b "$BRANCH" && git push -q -u origin "$BRANCH"
          fi
          echo "WORK_BRANCH=$BRANCH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Install OpenCode
        run: |
          set -e
          export PATH="$HOME/.opencode/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
          if ! command -v opencode >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash || true
          fi
          if ! command -v opencode >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            npm install -g opencode-ai
          fi
          command -v opencode
          opencode --version || true

      - name: Start OpenCode web and open the tunnel
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          FIRST_PROMPT: ${{ inputs.prompt }}
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
          SYMBIOSIS_KEY: ${{ secrets.SYMBIOSIS_KEY }}
          HF_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HF_TOKEN }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          OC_UI: ${{ inputs.ui }}
        run: |
          set -e
          export PATH="$HOME/.opencode/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
          cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork"

          # Headless serve + a one-file mobile chat. Official `opencode web`
          # is a heavy SPA that janks a phone WebView; the panel opens the
          # gateway at :4100 instead.
          mkdir -p "$HUB_LOGS" "$HOME/.npm-hub/logs" 2>/dev/null || true
          # The checkout is fresh on every runner. Reapply the previous
          # runner's uncommitted diff/untracked files before importing chats so
          # OpenCode starts in the same local repository state.
          GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" WORK_BACKUP_ROOT="$HOME" \
            WORK_BACKUP_RESTORE_EXISTING=1 bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/restore-work.sh" \
            2>&1 | tee -a "$HUB_LOGS/restore-work.log"
          cat > $HUB_LOGS/opencode.json <<'JSON'
          { "permission": { "*": "allow" } }
          JSON
          cp $HUB_LOGS/opencode.json "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/opencode.json" 2>/dev/null || true
          GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/restore_audit_code.sh" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork" 2>&1 | tee -a "$HUB_LOGS/restore.log"
          # Keep both committed and uncommitted local changes durable while
          # the OpenCode runner is alive.
          nohup env GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" GITHUB_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" WORK_BACKUP_ROOT="$HOME" WORK_BACKUP_INTERVAL=300 \
            bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/backup-work.sh" >> "$HUB_LOGS/work-backup.log" 2>&1 &

          nohup opencode serve --port 4096 --hostname 127.0.0.1 --cors '*' \
            > $HUB_LOGS/opencode.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > $HUB_LOGS/opencode.pid

          up=0
          for i in $(seq 1 40); do
            if curl -sf -o /dev/null -m 4 "http://127.0.0.1:4096/global/health" \
              || curl -sf -o /dev/null -m 4 "http://127.0.0.1:4096/session"; then
              up=1; break
            fi
            sleep 2
          done
          if [ "$up" != 1 ]; then
            echo "::error::OpenCode serve did not start."
            tail -50 $HUB_LOGS/opencode.log
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "OpenCode serve is up on 4096"
          export SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL=120
          nohup env GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" GITHUB_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/snapshot-audit-code.sh" opencode "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork" > "$HUB_LOGS/snapshot-opencode.log" 2>&1 &
          echo "opencode audit/code snapshot every 120s"

          node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/agent/oc-gateway.js" > $HUB_LOGS/oc-gateway.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > $HUB_LOGS/oc-gateway.pid
          gw=0
          for i in $(seq 1 20); do
            if curl -sf -o /dev/null -m 4 "http://127.0.0.1:4100/"; then gw=1; break; fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$gw" != 1 ]; then
            echo "::error::oc-gateway did not start."
            tail -40 $HUB_LOGS/oc-gateway.log
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ -n "$FIRST_PROMPT" ]; then
            python3 "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/oc_first_prompt.py" \
              || echo "::warning::first prompt failed; the chat is still up"
          fi

          URL=$(bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/open_tunnel.sh" 4100 $HUB_LOGS/oc-tunnel.log)
          if [ -z "$URL" ]; then
            echo "::error::no tunnel came up."
            tail -25 $HUB_LOGS/oc-tunnel.log
            exit 1
          fi
          printf '%s\n' "$URL" > "$HOME/.npm-hub/logs/opencode-url"

          {
            echo "## OpenCode"
            echo ""
            echo "**[Open OpenCode]($URL/)**"
            echo ""
            echo "| | |"
            echo "|---|---|"
            echo "| Address | \`$URL\` |"
            echo "| Branch | \`$WORK_BRANCH\` |"
            echo "| Runner | ubuntu-latest |"
            echo ""
            if [ "${OC_UI:-web}" = "web" ]; then
              echo "Original OpenCode web UI. Treat the link as a password."
            else
              echo "Mobile chat (lightweight, not the full web UI). Treat the link as a password."
            fi
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

          echo "=================================================="
          echo " OpenCode: $URL/"
          echo "=================================================="

          GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/publish_session.sh" \
              "slot=opencode-linux" "kind=OpenCode" "os=linux" \
              "url=$URL" "agentUrl=$URL/" \
              "branch=$WORK_BRANCH"

      - name: Keep the session alive
        env:
          OC_UI: ${{ inputs.ui }}
        run: |
          echo "Running until cancelled, or for six hours."
          export PATH="$HOME/.opencode/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
          export HUB_LOGS="$HOME/.npm-hub/logs"
          mkdir -p "$HUB_LOGS"
          for i in $(seq 1 1400); do
            sleep 15
            if ! curl -sf -o /dev/null -m 8 "http://127.0.0.1:4096/global/health" \
              || ! curl -sf -o /dev/null -m 8 "http://127.0.0.1:4100/"; then
              echo "::warning::OpenCode stopped answering; restarting serve + gateway."
              nohup opencode serve --port 4096 --hostname 127.0.0.1 --cors '*' \
                > "$HUB_LOGS/opencode2.log" 2>&1 &
              sleep 4
              node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/agent/oc-gateway.js" > "$HUB_LOGS/oc-gateway2.log" 2>&1 &
              sleep 6
            fi

            cur=$(cat "$HUB_LOGS/opencode-url" 2>/dev/null || true)
            pid=$(cat "$HUB_LOGS/cloudflared-4100.pid" 2>/dev/null || true)
            if [ -n "$cur" ] && [ -n "$pid" ] && kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null \
              && bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/tunnel_health.sh" "$cur" "/"; then
              continue
            fi
            echo "::warning::OpenCode tunnel is unavailable; replacing the stale URL."
            [ -n "$pid" ] && kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
            URL=$(bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/open_tunnel.sh" 4100 "$HUB_LOGS/oc-tunnel2.log") || continue
            [ -n "$URL" ] || continue
            printf '%s\n' "$URL" > "$HUB_LOGS/opencode-url"
            GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
              bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/publish_session.sh" \
                "slot=opencode-linux" "kind=OpenCode" "os=linux" \
                "url=$URL" "agentUrl=$URL/" "branch=$WORK_BRANCH"
          done

      - name: Snapshot audit/code on exit
        if: always()
        run: |
          export HUB_LOGS="$HOME/.npm-hub/logs"; mkdir -p "$HUB_LOGS" 2>/dev/null || true
          GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" GITHUB_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" WORK_BACKUP_ROOT="$HOME" \
            bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/backup-work.sh" --once \
             2>&1 | tee -a "$HUB_LOGS/work-backup.log"

          GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" GITHUB_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/snapshot-audit-code.sh" --once opencode "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork" 2>&1 | tee -a "$HUB_LOGS/snapshot-opencode.log"

      - name: Clear the published session
        if: always()
        run: |
          GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/publish_session.sh" \
              "slot=opencode-linux" "state=ended"

      - name: Save the models snapshot
        if: always()
        run: |
          # Same idea as the agent roster: whatever OpenCode learned about
          # models is copied to the session-state branch before the runner
          # dies. json= merges are secret-scrubbed, so opencode.json API
          # keys cannot land on the branch.
          GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/publish_session.sh" \
              "slot=opencode-linux" "file=models-opencode-linux.json" \
              "kind=OpenCode" "os=linux" "ui=${{ inputs.ui }}" \
               "json=$HOME/.config/opencode/opencode.json"


      - name: Final save
        if: always()
        run: |
          cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork" || exit 1
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            git add -A
            git commit -q -m "opencode final save $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')"
            git push -q origin HEAD
          fi

      - name: Record the run in the history
        if: always()
        run: |
          # One small file per run, filed under the day and the weekday it
          # belongs to: history/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<Wd>/run-<runNumber>.json - the
          # diary the panel groups by day, and unlike the Actions UI it does not
          # disappear when GitHub prunes old runs.
          STARTED=""
          if [ -f "$HOME/.npm-hub/session-start" ]; then
            STARTED="$(date -u -d "@$(( $(cat "$HOME/.npm-hub/session-start" 2>/dev/null || date +%s) / 1000 ))" '+%Y-%m-%d' 2>/dev/null || true)"
          fi
          GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/publish_session.sh" journal=1 \
              "slot=opencode-linux" "kind=OpenCode" "os=linux" \
              "conclusion=${{ job.status }}" "endedAt=$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')" \
              ${STARTED:+journal_date="$STARTED"} \
              "handoff=${{ inputs.handoff }}" \
              "runUrl=https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}" \
              2>&1 | tail -5 || echo "::warning::run history record failed"

  opencode-windows:
    if: inputs.os == 'windows'
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner_windows }}
    timeout-minutes: 360

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: fork
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'

      - name: Prepare the working branch
        working-directory: fork
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          git config user.email "opencode@zen-panel"
          git config user.name  "OpenCode"
          $branch = "${{ inputs.branch }}-windows"
          git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin $branch *> $null
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
            git branch -f $branch HEAD
            git checkout -q $branch
            git push -q --force-with-lease origin $branch
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { git push -q -f origin $branch }
          } else {
            git checkout -q -b $branch
            git push -q -u origin $branch
          }
          "WORK_BRANCH=$branch" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Append

      - name: Install OpenCode
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          npm install -g opencode-ai
          opencode --version

      - name: Start OpenCode web and open the tunnel
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          FIRST_PROMPT: ${{ inputs.prompt }}
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
          SYMBIOSIS_KEY: ${{ secrets.SYMBIOSIS_KEY }}
          HF_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HF_TOKEN }}
          OC_UI: ${{ inputs.ui }}
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
          Set-Location "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\fork"
          $env:GH_TOKEN = "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
          $env:WORK_BACKUP_ROOT = $HOME
          $env:WORK_BACKUP_RESTORE_EXISTING = "1"
          bash "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/restore-work.sh" 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath "$env:TEMP\restore-work.log"
          bash "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/restore_audit_code.sh" "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork" 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath "$env:TEMP\restore-audit.log"

          # cmd /c start, not Start-Process: a process started with
          # Start-Process is killed when its step ends.
          cmd /c start "" /b opencode serve --port 4096 --hostname 127.0.0.1 --cors * `
            "1>$env:TEMP\opencode.log" "2>$env:TEMP\opencode.err"

          $up = $false
          foreach ($i in 1..40) {
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
            try {
              Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:4096/global/health" -TimeoutSec 4 -UseBasicParsing | Out-Null
              $up = $true; break
            } catch { }
          }
          if (-not $up) {
            Write-Host "::error::OpenCode serve did not start."
            Get-Content "$env:TEMP\opencode.log", "$env:TEMP\opencode.err" -Tail 50 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            exit 1
          }
          Write-Host "OpenCode serve is up on 4096"

          cmd /c start "" /b node "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\fork\agent\oc-gateway.js" `
            "1>$env:TEMP\oc-gateway.log" "2>$env:TEMP\oc-gateway.err"
          $gw = $false
          foreach ($i in 1..20) {
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
            try {
              Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:4100/" -TimeoutSec 4 -UseBasicParsing | Out-Null
              $gw = $true; break
            } catch { }
          }
          if (-not $gw) {
            Write-Host "::error::oc-gateway did not start."
            Get-Content "$env:TEMP\oc-gateway.log", "$env:TEMP\oc-gateway.err" -Tail 40 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            exit 1
          }

          if ($env:FIRST_PROMPT) {
            python "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\fork\tools\oc_first_prompt.py"
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
              Write-Host "::warning::first prompt failed; the chat is still up"
            }
          }

          $cf = "$env:TEMP\cloudflared.exe"
          curl.exe -sL --retry 3 -o $cf `
            "https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/cloudflared-windows-amd64.exe"
          if (-not (Test-Path $cf)) { throw "could not download cloudflared" }

          $log = "$env:TEMP\cf-oc.log"
          cmd /c start "" /b "$cf" tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:4100 --no-autoupdate --loglevel info `
            "1>$log" "2>$env:TEMP\cf-oc.err"

          $url = $null
          foreach ($i in 1..40) {
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
            $text = (Get-Content $log, "$env:TEMP\cf-oc.err" -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join "`n"
            if ($text -match "https://[a-z0-9-]+\.trycloudflare\.com") { $url = $Matches[0]; break }
          }
          if (-not $url) {
            Write-Host "::error::no tunnel came up."
            Get-Content $log, "$env:TEMP\cf-oc.err" -Tail 25 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            exit 1
          }

          $edgeReady = $false
          $probe = "$env:TEMP\oc-tunnel-probe.html"
          foreach ($i in 1..30) {
            $code = curl.exe -sS -L -o $probe -w "%{http_code}" -m 15 "$url/"
            $body = Get-Content $probe -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            if ($code -match "^[234]" -and $body -notmatch "(?i)1033") { $edgeReady = $true; break }
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
          }
          if (-not $edgeReady) {
            Write-Host "::error::Cloudflare edge did not become ready (Error 1033)."
            Get-Process -Name cloudflared -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Get-Content $log, "$env:TEMP\cf-oc.err" -Tail 25 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            exit 1
          }

          $url | Out-File -FilePath "$env:TEMP\opencode-url.txt" -Encoding utf8 -NoNewline

          $summary = @(
            "## OpenCode (Windows)",
            "",
            "**[Open OpenCode]($url/)**",
            "",
            "| | |",
            "|---|---|",
            "| Address | ``$url`` |",
            "| Branch | ``$env:WORK_BRANCH`` |",
            "| Runner | windows-latest, 4 cores, 16 GB |",
            "",
            $(if ($env:OC_UI -eq "mobile") { "Mobile chat (lightweight, not the full web UI). Treat the link as a password." } else { "Original OpenCode web UI. Treat the link as a password." })
          ) -join "`n"
          $summary | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY -Append
          Write-Host "=================================================="
          Write-Host " OpenCode: $url/"
          Write-Host "=================================================="

          $env:GH_TOKEN = "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
          bash "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/publish_session.sh" `
            "slot=opencode-windows" "kind=OpenCode" "os=windows" `
            "url=$url" "agentUrl=$url/" `
            "branch=$env:WORK_BRANCH"

      - name: Keep the session alive
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Write-Host "Running until cancelled, or for six hours."
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 1400; $i++) {
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 15
            $code = (curl.exe -s -o NUL -w "%{http_code}" -m 10 "http://127.0.0.1:4096/global/health")
            $gcode = (curl.exe -s -o NUL -w "%{http_code}" -m 10 "http://127.0.0.1:4100/")
            if ($code -notmatch "^[234]" -or $gcode -notmatch "^[234]") {
              Write-Host "::warning::OpenCode stopped answering ($code/$gcode); restarting serve + gateway."
              cmd /c start "" /b opencode serve --port 4096 --hostname 127.0.0.1 --cors * `
                "1>$env:TEMP\opencode2.log" "2>$env:TEMP\opencode2.err"
              Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
              cmd /c start "" /b node "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\fork\agent\oc-gateway.js" `
                "1>$env:TEMP\oc-gateway2.log" "2>$env:TEMP\oc-gateway2.err"
              Start-Sleep -Seconds 10
            }

            $cur = ''
            try { $cur = (Get-Content "$env:TEMP\opencode-url.txt" -Raw -ErrorAction Stop).Trim() } catch { }
            $edgeOk = $false
            if ((Get-Process -Name cloudflared -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and $cur) {
              $probe = "$env:TEMP\oc-watch-probe.html"
              $edgeCode = curl.exe -sS -L -o $probe -w "%{http_code}" -m 10 "$cur/"
              $edgeBody = Get-Content $probe -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
              if ($edgeCode -match "^[234]" -and $edgeBody -notmatch "(?i)1033") { $edgeOk = $true }
            }
            if ($edgeOk) { continue }

            Write-Host "::warning::OpenCode tunnel is unavailable; replacing the stale URL."
            Get-Process -Name cloudflared -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            $log = "$env:TEMP\cf-oc2.log"
            cmd /c start "" /b "$env:TEMP\cloudflared.exe" tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:4100 --no-autoupdate --loglevel info `
              "1>$log" "2>$env:TEMP\cf-oc2.err"
            $url = $null
            foreach ($k in 1..40) {
              Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
              $text = (Get-Content $log, "$env:TEMP\cf-oc2.err" -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join "`n"
              if ($text -match "https://[a-z0-9-]+\.trycloudflare\.com") { $url = $Matches[0]; break }
            }
            if (-not $url) { continue }
            $edgeReady = $false
            $probe = "$env:TEMP\oc-tunnel-probe2.html"
            foreach ($k in 1..30) {
              $edgeCode = curl.exe -sS -L -o $probe -w "%{http_code}" -m 15 "$url/"
              $edgeBody = Get-Content $probe -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
              if ($edgeCode -match "^[234]" -and $edgeBody -notmatch "(?i)1033") { $edgeReady = $true; break }
              Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
            }
            if (-not $edgeReady) { continue }
            $url | Out-File -FilePath "$env:TEMP\opencode-url.txt" -Encoding utf8 -NoNewline
            $env:GH_TOKEN = "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
            bash "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/publish_session.sh" `
              "slot=opencode-windows" "kind=OpenCode" "os=windows" `
              "url=$url" "agentUrl=$url/" "branch=$env:WORK_BRANCH"
          }

      - name: Clear the published session
        if: always()
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $env:GH_TOKEN = "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
          bash "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/publish_session.sh" "slot=opencode-windows" "state=ended"

      - name: Save the models snapshot
        if: always()
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $env:GH_TOKEN = "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
          bash "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/publish_session.sh" `
            "slot=opencode-windows" "file=models-opencode-windows.json" `
            "kind=OpenCode" "os=windows" "ui=${{ inputs.ui }}" `
            "json=$env:USERPROFILE/.config/opencode/opencode.json"

      - name: Snapshot audit/code on exit
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          export HUB_LOGS="$HOME/.npm-hub/logs"; mkdir -p "$HUB_LOGS" 2>/dev/null || true
          GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" GITHUB_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/snapshot-audit-code.sh" --once opencode "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork" 2>&1 | tee -a "$HUB_LOGS/snapshot-opencode.log"

      - name: Final save
        if: always()
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Set-Location "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\fork"
          $env:GH_TOKEN = "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
          $env:WORK_BACKUP_ROOT = $HOME
          bash "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/backup-work.sh" --once 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath "$env:TEMP\work-backup.log"
          if (git status --porcelain) {
            git add -A
            git commit -q -m "opencode final save $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')"
            git push -q origin HEAD
          }

      - name: Record the run in the history
        if: always()
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # history/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<Wd>/run-<runNumber>.json - see the Linux step.
          $env:GH_TOKEN = "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
          bash "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/publish_session.sh" journal=1 `
            "slot=opencode-windows" "kind=OpenCode" "os=windows" `
            "conclusion=${{ job.status }}" "endedAt=$([DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ'))" `
            "handoff=${{ inputs.handoff }}" `
            "runUrl=https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}"

metadata.output:
name: OpenCode

# OpenCode serve + a mobile chat on a GitHub runner, published through a
# cloudflared quick tunnel. Official web UI is too heavy for a phone.
#
# Why a separate workflow: the Zen agent is this fork's own loop. OpenCode is
# a different product with its own models, tools and web client. Users pick
# linux or windows the same way they do for the agent.

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      os:
        description: "Runner OS"
        type: choice
        options: [linux, windows]
        default: linux
      ui:
        description: "Web interface: original SPA (web) or lightweight mobile chat (mobile)"
        type: choice
        options: [web, mobile]
        default: web
      prompt:
        description: "Optional first prompt, sent once the web UI is up"
        type: string
        default: ""
      branch:
        description: "Working branch (created if absent)"
        type: string
        default: "opencode-work"
      runner_linux:
        description: "Runner for the Linux job (a label, or self-hosted - see pc-local/runner)"
        type: string
        default: "ubuntu-latest"
      runner_windows:
        description: "Runner for the Windows job (a label, or self-hosted - see pc-local/runner)"
        type: string
        default: "windows-latest"

concurrency:
  group: zen-panel-session-${{ github.repository }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  HUB_LOGS: /home/runner/.npm-hub/logs

jobs:
  opencode-linux:
    if: inputs.os == 'linux'
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner_linux }}
    timeout-minutes: 360

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: fork
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'

      - name: Prepare the working branch
        working-directory: fork
        run: |
          git config user.email "opencode@zen-panel"
          git config user.name  "OpenCode"
          BRANCH="${{ inputs.branch }}"
          if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$BRANCH" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            git branch -f "$BRANCH" HEAD
            git checkout -q "$BRANCH"
            git push -q --force-with-lease origin "$BRANCH" || git push -q -f origin "$BRANCH"
          else
            git checkout -q -b "$BRANCH" && git push -q -u origin "$BRANCH"
          fi
          echo "WORK_BRANCH=$BRANCH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Install OpenCode
        run: |
          set -e
          export PATH="$HOME/.opencode/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
          if ! command -v opencode >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash || true
          fi
          if ! command -v opencode >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            npm install -g opencode-ai
          fi
          command -v opencode
          opencode --version || true

      - name: Start OpenCode web and open the tunnel
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          FIRST_PROMPT: ${{ inputs.prompt }}
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
          SYMBIOSIS_KEY: ${{ secrets.SYMBIOSIS_KEY }}
          HF_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HF_TOKEN }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          OC_UI: ${{ inputs.ui }}
        run: |
          set -e
          export PATH="$HOME/.opencode/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
          cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork"

          # Headless serve + a one-file mobile chat. Official `opencode web`
          # is a heavy SPA that janks a phone WebView; the panel opens the
          # gateway at :4100 instead.
          mkdir -p "$HUB_LOGS" "$HOME/.npm-hub/logs" 2>/dev/null || true
          # The checkout is fresh on every runner. Reapply the previous
          # runner's uncommitted diff/untracked files before importing chats so
          # OpenCode starts in the same local repository state.
          GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" WORK_BACKUP_ROOT="$HOME" \
            WORK_BACKUP_RESTORE_EXISTING=1 bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/restore-work.sh" \
            2>&1 | tee -a "$HUB_LOGS/restore-work.log"
          cat > $HUB_LOGS/opencode.json <<'JSON'
          { "permission": { "*": "allow" } }
          JSON
          cp $HUB_LOGS/opencode.json "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/opencode.json" 2>/dev/null || true
          GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/restore_audit_code.sh" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork" 2>&1 | tee -a "$HUB_LOGS/restore.log"
          # Keep both committed and uncommitted local changes durable while
          # the OpenCode runner is alive.
          nohup env GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" GITHUB_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" WORK_BACKUP_ROOT="$HOME" WORK_BACKUP_INTERVAL=300 \
            bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/backup-work.sh" >> "$HUB_LOGS/work-backup.log" 2>&1 &

          nohup opencode serve --port 4096 --hostname 127.0.0.1 --cors '*' \
            > $HUB_LOGS/opencode.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > $HUB_LOGS/opencode.pid

          up=0
          for i in $(seq 1 40); do
            if curl -sf -o /dev/null -m 4 "http://127.0.0.1:4096/global/health" \
              || curl -sf -o /dev/null -m 4 "http://127.0.0.1:4096/session"; then
              up=1; break
            fi
            sleep 2
          done
          if [ "$up" != 1 ]; then
            echo "::error::OpenCode serve did not start."
            tail -50 $HUB_LOGS/opencode.log
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "OpenCode serve is up on 4096"
          export SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL=120
          nohup env GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" GITHUB_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/snapshot-audit-code.sh" opencode "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork" > "$HUB_LOGS/snapshot-opencode.log" 2>&1 &
          echo "opencode audit/code snapshot every 120s"

          node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/agent/oc-gateway.js" > $HUB_LOGS/oc-gateway.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > $HUB_LOGS/oc-gateway.pid
          gw=0
          for i in $(seq 1 20); do
            if curl -sf -o /dev/null -m 4 "http://127.0.0.1:4100/"; then gw=1; break; fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$gw" != 1 ]; then
            echo "::error::oc-gateway did not start."
            tail -40 $HUB_LOGS/oc-gateway.log
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ -n "$FIRST_PROMPT" ]; then
            python3 "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/oc_first_prompt.py" \
              || echo "::warning::first prompt failed; the chat is still up"
          fi

          URL=$(bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/open_tunnel.sh" 4100 $HUB_LOGS/oc-tunnel.log)
          if [ -z "$URL" ]; then
            echo "::error::no tunnel came up."
            tail -25 $HUB_LOGS/oc-tunnel.log
            exit 1
          fi
          printf '%s\n' "$URL" > "$HOME/.npm-hub/logs/opencode-url"

          {
            echo "## OpenCode"
            echo ""
            echo "**[Open OpenCode]($URL/)**"
            echo ""
            echo "| | |"
            echo "|---|---|"
            echo "| Address | \`$URL\` |"
            echo "| Branch | \`$WORK_BRANCH\` |"
            echo "| Runner | ubuntu-latest |"
            echo ""
            if [ "${OC_UI:-web}" = "web" ]; then
              echo "Original OpenCode web UI. Treat the link as a password."
            else
              echo "Mobile chat (lightweight, not the full web UI). Treat the link as a password."
            fi
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

          echo "=================================================="
          echo " OpenCode: $URL/"
          echo "=================================================="

          GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/publish_session.sh" \
              "slot=opencode-linux" "kind=OpenCode" "os=linux" \
              "url=$URL" "agentUrl=$URL/" \
              "branch=$WORK_BRANCH"

      - name: Keep the session alive
        env:
          OC_UI: ${{ inputs.ui }}
        run: |
          echo "Running until cancelled, or for six hours."
          export PATH="$HOME/.opencode/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
          export HUB_LOGS="$HOME/.npm-hub/logs"
          mkdir -p "$HUB_LOGS"
          for i in $(seq 1 1400); do
            sleep 15
            if ! curl -sf -o /dev/null -m 8 "http://127.0.0.1:4096/global/health" \
              || ! curl -sf -o /dev/null -m 8 "http://127.0.0.1:4100/"; then
              echo "::warning::OpenCode stopped answering; restarting serve + gateway."
              nohup opencode serve --port 4096 --hostname 127.0.0.1 --cors '*' \
                > "$HUB_LOGS/opencode2.log" 2>&1 &
              sleep 4
              node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/agent/oc-gateway.js" > "$HUB_LOGS/oc-gateway2.log" 2>&1 &
              sleep 6
            fi

            cur=$(cat "$HUB_LOGS/opencode-url" 2>/dev/null || true)
            pid=$(cat "$HUB_LOGS/cloudflared-4100.pid" 2>/dev/null || true)
            if [ -n "$cur" ] && [ -n "$pid" ] && kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null \
              && bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/tunnel_health.sh" "$cur" "/"; then
              continue
            fi
            echo "::warning::OpenCode tunnel is unavailable; replacing the stale URL."
            [ -n "$pid" ] && kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
            URL=$(bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/open_tunnel.sh" 4100 "$HUB_LOGS/oc-tunnel2.log") || continue
            [ -n "$URL" ] || continue
            printf '%s\n' "$URL" > "$HUB_LOGS/opencode-url"
            GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
              bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/publish_session.sh" \
                "slot=opencode-linux" "kind=OpenCode" "os=linux" \
                "url=$URL" "agentUrl=$URL/" "branch=$WORK_BRANCH"
          done

      - name: Snapshot audit/code on exit
        if: always()
        run: |
          export HUB_LOGS="$HOME/.npm-hub/logs"; mkdir -p "$HUB_LOGS" 2>/dev/null || true
          GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" GITHUB_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" WORK_BACKUP_ROOT="$HOME" \
            bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/backup-work.sh" --once \
             2>&1 | tee -a "$HUB_LOGS/work-backup.log"

          GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" GITHUB_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/snapshot-audit-code.sh" --once opencode "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork" 2>&1 | tee -a "$HUB_LOGS/snapshot-opencode.log"

      - name: Clear the published session
        if: always()
        run: |
          GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/publish_session.sh" \
              "slot=opencode-linux" "state=ended"

      - name: Save the models snapshot
        if: always()
        run: |
          # Same idea as the agent roster: whatever OpenCode learned about
          # models is copied to the session-state branch before the runner
          # dies. json= merges are secret-scrubbed, so opencode.json API
          # keys cannot land on the branch.
          GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/publish_session.sh" \
              "slot=opencode-linux" "file=models-opencode-linux.json" \
              "kind=OpenCode" "os=linux" "ui=${{ inputs.ui }}" \
               "json=$HOME/.config/opencode/opencode.json"


      - name: Final save
        if: always()
        run: |
          cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork" || exit 1
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            git add -A
            git commit -q -m "opencode final save $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')"
            git push -q origin HEAD
          fi

      - name: Record the run in the history
        if: always()
        run: |
          # One small file per run, filed under the day and the weekday it
          # belongs to: history/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<Wd>/run-<runNumber>.json - the
          # diary the panel groups by day, and unlike the Actions UI it does not
          # disappear when GitHub prunes old runs.
          STARTED=""
          if [ -f "$HOME/.npm-hub/session-start" ]; then
            STARTED="$(date -u -d "@$(( $(cat "$HOME/.npm-hub/session-start" 2>/dev/null || date +%s) / 1000 ))" '+%Y-%m-%d' 2>/dev/null || true)"
          fi
          GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/publish_session.sh" journal=1 \
              "slot=opencode-linux" "kind=OpenCode" "os=linux" \
              "conclusion=${{ job.status }}" "endedAt=$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')" \
              ${STARTED:+journal_date="$STARTED"} \
              "handoff=${{ inputs.handoff }}" \
              "runUrl=https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}" \
              2>&1 | tail -5 || echo "::warning::run history record failed"

  opencode-windows:
    if: inputs.os == 'windows'
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner_windows }}
    timeout-minutes: 360

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: fork
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'

      - name: Prepare the working branch
        working-directory: fork
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          git config user.email "opencode@zen-panel"
          git config user.name  "OpenCode"
          $branch = "${{ inputs.branch }}-windows"
          git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin $branch *> $null
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
            git branch -f $branch HEAD
            git checkout -q $branch
            git push -q --force-with-lease origin $branch
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { git push -q -f origin $branch }
          } else {
            git checkout -q -b $branch
            git push -q -u origin $branch
          }
          "WORK_BRANCH=$branch" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Append

      - name: Install OpenCode
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          npm install -g opencode-ai
          opencode --version

      - name: Start OpenCode web and open the tunnel
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          FIRST_PROMPT: ${{ inputs.prompt }}
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
          SYMBIOSIS_KEY: ${{ secrets.SYMBIOSIS_KEY }}
          HF_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HF_TOKEN }}
          OC_UI: ${{ inputs.ui }}
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
          Set-Location "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\fork"
          $env:GH_TOKEN = "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
          $env:WORK_BACKUP_ROOT = $HOME
          $env:WORK_BACKUP_RESTORE_EXISTING = "1"
          bash "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/restore-work.sh" 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath "$env:TEMP\restore-work.log"
          bash "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/restore_audit_code.sh" "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork" 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath "$env:TEMP\restore-audit.log"

          # cmd /c start, not Start-Process: a process started with
          # Start-Process is killed when its step ends.
          cmd /c start "" /b opencode serve --port 4096 --hostname 127.0.0.1 --cors * `
            "1>$env:TEMP\opencode.log" "2>$env:TEMP\opencode.err"

          $up = $false
          foreach ($i in 1..40) {
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
            try {
              Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:4096/global/health" -TimeoutSec 4 -UseBasicParsing | Out-Null
              $up = $true; break
            } catch { }
          }
          if (-not $up) {
            Write-Host "::error::OpenCode serve did not start."
            Get-Content "$env:TEMP\opencode.log", "$env:TEMP\opencode.err" -Tail 50 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            exit 1
          }
          Write-Host "OpenCode serve is up on 4096"

          cmd /c start "" /b node "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\fork\agent\oc-gateway.js" `
            "1>$env:TEMP\oc-gateway.log" "2>$env:TEMP\oc-gateway.err"
          $gw = $false
          foreach ($i in 1..20) {
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
            try {
              Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:4100/" -TimeoutSec 4 -UseBasicParsing | Out-Null
              $gw = $true; break
            } catch { }
          }
          if (-not $gw) {
            Write-Host "::error::oc-gateway did not start."
            Get-Content "$env:TEMP\oc-gateway.log", "$env:TEMP\oc-gateway.err" -Tail 40 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            exit 1
          }

          if ($env:FIRST_PROMPT) {
            python "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\fork\tools\oc_first_prompt.py"
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
              Write-Host "::warning::first prompt failed; the chat is still up"
            }
          }

          $cf = "$env:TEMP\cloudflared.exe"
          curl.exe -sL --retry 3 -o $cf `
            "https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/cloudflared-windows-amd64.exe"
          if (-not (Test-Path $cf)) { throw "could not download cloudflared" }

          $log = "$env:TEMP\cf-oc.log"
          cmd /c start "" /b "$cf" tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:4100 --no-autoupdate --loglevel info `
            "1>$log" "2>$env:TEMP\cf-oc.err"

          $url = $null
          foreach ($i in 1..40) {
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
            $text = (Get-Content $log, "$env:TEMP\cf-oc.err" -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join "`n"
            if ($text -match "https://[a-z0-9-]+\.trycloudflare\.com") { $url = $Matches[0]; break }
          }
          if (-not $url) {
            Write-Host "::error::no tunnel came up."
            Get-Content $log, "$env:TEMP\cf-oc.err" -Tail 25 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            exit 1
          }

          $edgeReady = $false
          $probe = "$env:TEMP\oc-tunnel-probe.html"
          foreach ($i in 1..30) {
            $code = curl.exe -sS -L -o $probe -w "%{http_code}" -m 15 "$url/"
            $body = Get-Content $probe -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            if ($code -match "^[234]" -and $body -notmatch "(?i)1033") { $edgeReady = $true; break }
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
          }
          if (-not $edgeReady) {
            Write-Host "::error::Cloudflare edge did not become ready (Error 1033)."
            Get-Process -Name cloudflared -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Get-Content $log, "$env:TEMP\cf-oc.err" -Tail 25 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            exit 1
          }

          $url | Out-File -FilePath "$env:TEMP\opencode-url.txt" -Encoding utf8 -NoNewline

          $summary = @(
            "## OpenCode (Windows)",
            "",
            "**[Open OpenCode]($url/)**",
            "",
            "| | |",
            "|---|---|",
            "| Address | ``$url`` |",
            "| Branch | ``$env:WORK_BRANCH`` |",
            "| Runner | windows-latest, 4 cores, 16 GB |",
            "",
            $(if ($env:OC_UI -eq "mobile") { "Mobile chat (lightweight, not the full web UI). Treat the link as a password." } else { "Original OpenCode web UI. Treat the link as a password." })
          ) -join "`n"
          $summary | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY -Append
          Write-Host "=================================================="
          Write-Host " OpenCode: $url/"
          Write-Host "=================================================="

          $env:GH_TOKEN = "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
          bash "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/publish_session.sh" `
            "slot=opencode-windows" "kind=OpenCode" "os=windows" `
            "url=$url" "agentUrl=$url/" `
            "branch=$env:WORK_BRANCH"

      - name: Keep the session alive
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Write-Host "Running until cancelled, or for six hours."
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 1400; $i++) {
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 15
            $code = (curl.exe -s -o NUL -w "%{http_code}" -m 10 "http://127.0.0.1:4096/global/health")
            $gcode = (curl.exe -s -o NUL -w "%{http_code}" -m 10 "http://127.0.0.1:4100/")
            if ($code -notmatch "^[234]" -or $gcode -notmatch "^[234]") {
              Write-Host "::warning::OpenCode stopped answering ($code/$gcode); restarting serve + gateway."
              cmd /c start "" /b opencode serve --port 4096 --hostname 127.0.0.1 --cors * `
                "1>$env:TEMP\opencode2.log" "2>$env:TEMP\opencode2.err"
              Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
              cmd /c start "" /b node "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\fork\agent\oc-gateway.js" `
                "1>$env:TEMP\oc-gateway2.log" "2>$env:TEMP\oc-gateway2.err"
              Start-Sleep -Seconds 10
            }

            $cur = ''
            try { $cur = (Get-Content "$env:TEMP\opencode-url.txt" -Raw -ErrorAction Stop).Trim() } catch { }
            $edgeOk = $false
            if ((Get-Process -Name cloudflared -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and $cur) {
              $probe = "$env:TEMP\oc-watch-probe.html"
              $edgeCode = curl.exe -sS -L -o $probe -w "%{http_code}" -m 10 "$cur/"
              $edgeBody = Get-Content $probe -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
              if ($edgeCode -match "^[234]" -and $edgeBody -notmatch "(?i)1033") { $edgeOk = $true }
            }
            if ($edgeOk) { continue }

            Write-Host "::warning::OpenCode tunnel is unavailable; replacing the stale URL."
            Get-Process -Name cloudflared -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            $log = "$env:TEMP\cf-oc2.log"
            cmd /c start "" /b "$env:TEMP\cloudflared.exe" tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:4100 --no-autoupdate --loglevel info `
              "1>$log" "2>$env:TEMP\cf-oc2.err"
            $url = $null
            foreach ($k in 1..40) {
              Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
              $text = (Get-Content $log, "$env:TEMP\cf-oc2.err" -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join "`n"
              if ($text -match "https://[a-z0-9-]+\.trycloudflare\.com") { $url = $Matches[0]; break }
            }
            if (-not $url) { continue }
            $edgeReady = $false
            $probe = "$env:TEMP\oc-tunnel-probe2.html"
            foreach ($k in 1..30) {
              $edgeCode = curl.exe -sS -L -o $probe -w "%{http_code}" -m 15 "$url/"
              $edgeBody = Get-Content $probe -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
              if ($edgeCode -match "^[234]" -and $edgeBody -notmatch "(?i)1033") { $edgeReady = $true; break }
              Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
            }
            if (-not $edgeReady) { continue }
            $url | Out-File -FilePath "$env:TEMP\opencode-url.txt" -Encoding utf8 -NoNewline
            $env:GH_TOKEN = "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
            bash "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/publish_session.sh" `
              "slot=opencode-windows" "kind=OpenCode" "os=windows" `
              "url=$url" "agentUrl=$url/" "branch=$env:WORK_BRANCH"
          }

      - name: Clear the published session
        if: always()
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $env:GH_TOKEN = "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
          bash "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/publish_session.sh" "slot=opencode-windows" "state=ended"

      - name: Save the models snapshot
        if: always()
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $env:GH_TOKEN = "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
          bash "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/publish_session.sh" `
            "slot=opencode-windows" "file=models-opencode-windows.json" `
            "kind=OpenCode" "os=windows" "ui=${{ inputs.ui }}" `
            "json=$env:USERPROFILE/.config/opencode/opencode.json"

      - name: Snapshot audit/code on exit
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          export HUB_LOGS="$HOME/.npm-hub/logs"; mkdir -p "$HUB_LOGS" 2>/dev/null || true
          GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" GITHUB_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/snapshot-audit-code.sh" --once opencode "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork" 2>&1 | tee -a "$HUB_LOGS/snapshot-opencode.log"

      - name: Final save
        if: always()
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Set-Location "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\fork"
          $env:GH_TOKEN = "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
          $env:WORK_BACKUP_ROOT = $HOME
          bash "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/backup-work.sh" --once 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath "$env:TEMP\work-backup.log"
          if (git status --porcelain) {
            git add -A
            git commit -q -m "opencode final save $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')"
            git push -q origin HEAD
          }

      - name: Record the run in the history
        if: always()
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # history/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<Wd>/run-<runNumber>.json - see the Linux step.
          $env:GH_TOKEN = "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
          bash "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/publish_session.sh" journal=1 `
            "slot=opencode-windows" "kind=OpenCode" "os=windows" `
            "conclusion=${{ job.status }}" "endedAt=$([DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ'))" `
            "handoff=${{ inputs.handoff }}" `
            "runUrl=https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Save everything worth keeping BEFORE the next runner takes the session over.
#
# WHY A SEPARATE SCRIPT
#   The relay (npm-hub/src/handoff.js) decides WHEN to hand over; this script
#   does the part that must not be re-implemented in JavaScript: the durable
#   push. Its contract is deliberately blunt - exit 0 only when everything the
#   next runner needs is really on GitHub, non-zero otherwise. A failed push
#   must keep the old runner alive (the server treats non-zero as "stay here
#   and retry"), never hand over an unsaved session.
#
# WHAT IS SAVED
#   work-backup branch : every repo (bundle + uncommitted diff + untracked),
#                        loose home files, files >25 MB as chunks
#   session-state      : the OpenCode chat bundles (chats/<repo>.json) and the
#                        session descriptor with handoff=1 + who handed over
#
# ENV
#   GH_TOKEN / GITHUB_TOKEN   token for both branches
#   GITHUB_REPOSITORY         control repository
#   HANDOFF_SLOT              session slot to stamp (default hub-linux)
#   HANDOFF_KIND              session kind  (default NPM-Hub)
#   HANDOFF_LABEL             session label (default handoff)
#   HANDOFF_URL               current address, republished with the marker
#   WORK_BACKUP_ROOT          root the backup scans (default $HOME)
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
HUB_LOGS="${HUB_LOGS:-$HOME/.npm-hub/logs}"
mkdir -p "$HUB_LOGS" 2>/dev/null || true
log() { echo "[handoff $(date -u '+%H:%M:%S')] $*" | tee -a "$HUB_LOGS/handoff.log"; }

SLOT="${HANDOFF_SLOT:-hub-linux}"
KIND="${HANDOFF_KIND:-NPM-Hub}"
LABEL="${HANDOFF_LABEL:-handoff}"
RUN_ID="${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}"
STARTED="${HANDOFF_STARTED_AT:-}"

if [ -z "${GH_TOKEN:-}${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
  log "no GitHub token: refusing to hand over an unsaved session"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Round-trip test for tools/backup-work.sh + tools/restore-work.sh, using a
# local bare repo as the "work-backup" remote. No network, no GitHub.
set -uo pipefail
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
TOOLS="$HERE/../tools"
TMP="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'cd /; rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
pass=0; fail=0
check() { if [ "$2" = 1 ]; then pass=$((pass+1)); echo "PASS $1"; else fail=$((fail+1)); echo "FAIL $1"; fi; }

git init -q --bare "$TMP/remote.git"
mkdir -p "$TMP/home/proj/sub" "$TMP/home/loose"
( cd "$TMP/home/proj"
  git init -q; git config user.email t@t; git config user.name t
  echo base > committed.txt; printf 'build/\n' > .gitignore
  git add -A; git commit -qm base
  echo "wip change" >> committed.txt
  echo "staged" > newfile.txt; git add newfile.txt
  echo "untracked" > sub/scratch.txt
  echo "manifest" > MANIFEST.md
  mkdir -p build; echo junk > build/out.o )

echo "hello loose" > "$TMP/home/loose/note.txt"

CHAT_REPOS=$(CHAT_ALL_ROOT="$TMP/home" OPENCODE_DB="$TMP/missing.db" PUBLISH=0 bash "$TOOLS/export-chats.sh" --all 2>&1 | grep -c '^export-chats: --- ' || true)
check "chat export finds every repo" "$([ "$REPO_COUNT" = "$CHAT_REPOS" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)"

export SESSION_STATE_URL="$TMP/remote.git" WORK_BACKUP_ROOT="$TMP/home"
export WORK_BACKUP_STATE="$TMP/home/.npm-hub/work-backup-state" HUB_LOGS="$TMP/logs"
bash "$TOOLS/backup-work.sh" --once >/dev/null 2>&1
check "snapshot published" "$([ -n "$(git -C "$TMP/remote.git" ls-tree -r --name-only work-backup)" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
check "manifest lists proj" "$(git -C "$TMP/remote.git" show work-backup:latest.json | grep -q '"rel": "proj"' && echo 1 || echo 0)"
before="$(git -C "$TMP/remote.git" rev-parse work-backup)"
sleep 1
bash "$TOOLS/backup-work.sh" --once >/dev/null 2>&1
check "final once always publishes" "$([ "$before" != "$(git -C "$TMP/remote.git" rev-parse work-backup)" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)"

echo "second distinct edit" >> "$TMP/home/proj/committed.txt"
mkdir -p "$TMP/home/.npm-hub/sessions"
printf '%s\n' '{"id":"term_1","toolId":"opencode"}' > "$TMP/home/.npm-hub/sessions/npmhub-term_1.meta.json"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Autopilot for the fork: commit, push, open a PR, merge it, come back to main.
#
# WHY THIS EXISTS
#   The agent works for hours while nobody is watching. Every step of shipping
#   used to be a step somebody had to be awake for: someone had to notice the
#   changes were done, commit them, push, wait for CI, and merge. The existing
#   autosave in agent.yml only did `git add -A && git push` onto the working
#   branch - durable, yes, but nothing ever reached main, so the next runner
#   started from main and did not see the day's work.
#
# WHAT IT DOES, every tick
#   1. If the tree is dirty: commit it (message from AUTOSHIP_MESSAGE or a
#      summary of what changed).
#   2. Push the working branch.
#   3. Open a PR into main if there is none for this branch.
#   4. Merge it once CI is green.
#   5. Return to main and pull, so the next change starts from the merged state.
#
# THE ONE RULE THAT MATTERS
#   Never merge red. Tests run first; a failing suite ends the tick with the
#   branch pushed but the PR left open. The user asked for hands-off, not for
#   hands-off into a broken main - a broken main is a bug that costs a whole
#   morning, which is exactly the loss this script exists to prevent.
#
# USAGE
#   auto-ship.sh --once     one full tick, then exit (tests use this)
#   auto-ship.sh            daemon: a tick every AUTOSHIP_INTERVAL seconds
#
# ENV
#   AUTOSHIP_INTERVAL       seconds between ticks        (default 120)
#   AUTOSHIP_TEST_CMD       test command, empty = skip   (default npm test in tests/)
#   AUTOSHIP_BRANCH         working branch               (default: current)
#   AUTOSHIP_BASE           target branch for the PR      (default main)
#   AUTOSHIP_MESSAGE        commit message prefix
#   AUTOSHIP_NO_MERGE=1     push and open the PR, never merge
#   GH_TOKEN / GITHUB_TOKEN token for push and PR
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
HUB_LOGS="${HUB_LOGS:-$HOME/.npm-hub/logs}"
mkdir -p "$HUB_LOGS" 2>/dev/null || true
LOG="$HUB_LOGS/auto-ship.log"
log() { echo "[auto-ship $(date -u '+%H:%M:%S')] $*" | tee -a "$LOG" >&2; }

REPO="${AUTOSHIP_REPO:-$PWD}"
BASE="${AUTOSHIP_BASE:-main}"
BRANCH="${AUTOSHIP_BRANCH:-}"
INTERVAL="${AUTOSHIP_INTERVAL:-120}"
MESSAGE="${AUTOSHIP_MESSAGE:-}"
ONCE=0
[ "${1:-}" = "--once" ] && ONCE=1

command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "no git"; exit 1; }
cd "$REPO" || { log "no such repo: $REPO"; exit 1; }
git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "not a git repo: $REPO"; exit 1; }
[ -n "$BRANCH" ] || BRANCH="$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)"
[ "$BRANCH" = "HEAD" ] && BRANCH="${AUTOSHIP_BRANCH_FALLBACK:-autoship}"

# gh is how the PR and the merge happen. Without it we can still commit and
# push, which is the part that must never be skipped.
HAS_GH=0
command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && HAS_GH=1

# ── tests ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Returns 0 green, 1 red, 2 "could not tell" (no test command, deps missing).
# 2 must NOT be read as green: an unrunnable suite is not a passing suite, and
# the difference is exactly the broken main this script is meant to prevent.
run_tests() {
  local cmd="${AUTOSHIP_TEST_CMD-}"
  if [ -z "$cmd" ]; then
    if [ -f "$REPO/tests/package.json" ] && [ -d "$REPO/tests/node_modules" ]; then
      cmd="npm test"
    else
      log "no test command and no installed deps: skipping"
      return 2
    fi
  fi
  log "tests: $cmd"
  if ( cd "$REPO/tests" 2>/dev/null && eval "$cmd" ) >"$LOG.tests" 2>&1; then
    log "tests green"
    rm -f "$LOG.tests"
    return 0
  fi
  local bad
  bad="$(grep -Ei '[0-9]+ (failed|checks?, [1-9][0-9]* failed)|FAIL ' "$LOG.tests" 2>/dev/null | tail -3 | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "tests RED: ${bad:-see $LOG.tests}"
  return 1
}

# ── commit ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Only tracked-intent files. `git add -A` in a repo that carries a build/ or a
# node_modules/ would commit hundreds of megabytes of output; the ignore file is
# the contract, and this is where it is honoured.
commit_changes() {
  [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ] || return 1
  local what summary
  what="$(git status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
  summary="$(git status --porcelain | awk '{print $NF}' | head -6 | tr '\n' ' ')"
  git add -A || { log "git add failed"; return 1; }
  local msg="${MESSAGE:-agent $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}"
  [ -n "$MESSAGE" ] || msg="$msg

$what file(s): $summary"
  if git commit -q -m "$msg"; then
    log "committed $what file(s): $summary"
    return 0
  fi
  log "nothing to commit after add (ignored everything?)"
  return 1
}

push_branch() {
  if git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name '@{u}' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    git push -q -u origin "$BRANCH" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG" && return 0
  fi
  git push -q -u origin "$BRANCH" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"
}

# ── PR ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pr_number() { gh pr list --head "$BRANCH" --base "$BASE" --state open \
                --json number --jq '.[0].number' 2>/dev/null; }

open_pr() {
  [ "$HAS_GH" = 1 ] || { log "no gh: cannot open a PR"; return 1; }
  if [ -n "$(pr_number)" ]; then return 0; fi
  local title body
  title="$(git log -1 --pretty=%s)"
  body="$(git log --pretty='- %s' "origin/$BASE..$BRANCH" 2>/dev/null | head -30)"
  if gh pr create --base "$BASE" --head "$BRANCH" \
      --title "$title" --body "$body" >>"$LOG" 2>&1; then
    log "PR opened into $BASE: $(pr_number)"
    return 0
  fi
  log "gh pr create failed (see $LOG)"
  return 1
}

# Green means the required checks are done and passing. `gh pr checks` exits 8
# when checks are still pending, non-zero on failure, 0 when all pass; the empty
# case (no checks configured) counts as green, otherwise nothing would ever
# merge on a repo without CI.
pr_green() {
  [ "$HAS_GH" = 1 ] || return 1
  local pr; pr="$(pr_number)"; [ -n "$pr" ] || return 1
  local state
  state="$(gh pr view "$pr" --json mergeable,reviewDecision,statusCheckRollup \
            --jq '[.mergeable, (.statusCheckRollup | if length == 0 then "none"
                      else ([.[] | select(.conclusion != "SUCCESS" and
                                          .conclusion != "NEUTRAL" and
                                          .conclusion != "SKIPPED")] | length)
                      | tostring + ":" + (if . == 0 then "green" else "notgreen" end)
                      end)] | join(" ")' 2>/dev/null)"
  case "$state" in
    *"MERGEABLE"*"notgreen"*) log "CI not green yet"; return 1 ;;
    *notgreen*) log "CI not green yet"; return 1 ;;
    *CONFLICTING*|*MERGEABLE=*UNKNOWN*) log "merge conflict"; return 1 ;;
    "") log "could not read PR state"; return 1 ;;
    *) return 0 ;;
  esac
}

merge_pr() {
  [ "$HAS_GH" = 1 ] || return 1
  local pr; pr="$(pr_number)"; [ -n "$pr" ] || return 1
  if gh pr merge "$pr" --squash --delete-branch >>"$LOG" 2>&1; then
    log "PR #$pr merged into $BASE"
    return 0
  fi
  log "merge failed for #$pr (see $LOG)"
  return 1
}

return_to_base() {
  # Off the branch is what we want: the next commit starts from what main now
  # contains, so the next PR is a diff of new work rather than a replay.
  git checkout -q "$BASE" 2>/dev/null || return 1
  git pull -q --ff-only origin "$BASE" >>"$LOG" 2>&1
}

tick() {
  git fetch -q origin "$BASE" 2>>"$LOG" || log "fetch failed (offline? will retry)"

  commit_changes || true
  [ -n "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ] && {
    log "still dirty after commit; skipping this tick"
    return 1
  }

  if ! push_branch; then
    log "push failed: keeping the commit local and retrying next tick"
    return 1
  fi

  # Not on base = there is something to propose. On base = nothing new yet.
  git rev-parse --verify --quiet "origin/$BRANCH" >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
  if [ "$(git rev-list --count "origin/$BASE..$BRANCH" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" = 0 ]; then
    return_to_base && log "up to date with $BASE"
    return 0
  fi

  open_pr || return 1

  local rc=0
  run_tests || rc=$?
  if [ "$rc" = 1 ]; then
    log "PR left open: tests are red"
    return 1
  fi
  if [ "${AUTOSHIP_NO_MERGE:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    log "PR left open: AUTOSHIP_NO_MERGE=1"
    return 0
  fi
  pr_green || { log "PR left open until CI is green"; return 1; }
  merge_pr || return 1
  return_to_base
  log "merged and back on $BASE"
}

if [ "$ONCE" = 1 ]; then
  tick
  exit $?
fi

log "autopilot on $BRANCH -> $BASE every ${INTERVAL}s (tests: ${AUTOSHIP_TEST_CMD:-auto})"
while true; do
  tick || true
  sleep "$INTERVAL"
done

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# tools/auto-ship.sh against a local bare repo standing in for GitHub.
# No network. What is verified here is the behaviour that matters: it merges,
# it does not merge red, and it refuses to report green for a suite that never
# ran.
set -uo pipefail
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
TOOLS="$HERE/../tools"
TMP="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'cd /; rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
pass=0; fail=0
check() { if [ "$2" = 1 ]; then pass=$((pass+1)); echo "PASS $1"; else fail=$((fail+1)); echo "FAIL $1"; fi; }

# ── a bare "origin" and a working clone ──────────────────────────────────────
git init -q --bare "$TMP/origin.git"
mkdir -p "$TMP/w"
git clone -q "$TMP/origin.git" "$TMP/w"
( cd "$TMP/w"
  git config user.email t@t; git config user.name t
  git checkout -q -b main 2>/dev/null || git checkout -q main
  echo base > base.txt; printf 'build/\nnode_modules/\n' > .gitignore
  git add -A; git commit -qm base; git push -q -u origin main )

export HUB_LOGS="$TMP/logs"
export AUTOSHIP_REPO="$TMP/w"
export AUTOSHIP_BRANCH=main
# gh is absent in this sandbox on purpose: it must degrade to commit+push and
# say so, rather than silently claiming a PR exists.
export PATH="/nonexistent-for-gh-test:$PATH"

# ── 1. red suite: the change is still pushed and committed, nothing claims green
( cd "$TMP/w" && echo change >> base.txt && echo built > build/out.o && mkdir -p node_modules && echo big > node_modules/pkg.js )
AUTOSHIP_TEST_CMD='sh -c "echo 3 passed, 1 failed; exit 1"' \
  bash "$TOOLS/auto-ship.sh" --once >/dev/null 2>&1
check "red tests still commit" "$([ "$(git -C "$TMP/w" rev-list --count HEAD)" -gt 1 ] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
check "red tests still push" "$(git -C "$TMP/origin.git" rev-list --count main | grep -qv '^1$' && echo 1 || echo 0)"
check "red run does not claim green" "$(grep -q 'tests RED' "$HUB_LOGS/auto-ship.log" && echo 1 || echo 0)"
check "build output is not committed" "$(git -C "$TMP/w" ls-files | grep -qv 'build/out.o' && echo 1 || echo 0)"
check "node_modules is not committed" "$(git -C "$TMP/w" ls-files | grep -qv 'node_modules' && echo 1 || echo 0)"

# ── 2. an unrunnable suite is not a passing suite ───────────────────────────
# AUTOSHIP_TEST_CMD pointing at a missing binary: exit code is 127, which is
# neither the green nor the red path, and must not be read as green.
: > "$HUB_LOGS/auto-ship.log"
( cd "$TMP/w" && echo more >> base.txt )
AUTOSHIP_TEST_CMD='definitely-not-a-command-xyz' \
  bash "$TOOLS/auto-ship.sh" --once >/dev/null 2>&1
check "missing test binary is not reported green" "$(grep -q 'tests RED' "$HUB_LOGS/auto-ship.log" && echo 1 || echo 0)"
check "missing test binary does not print tests green" "$(grep -q 'tests green' "$HUB_LOGS/auto-ship.log" && echo 0 || echo 1)"

# ── 3. green suite with no gh: commit+push happen, PR is honestly skipped ────
: > "$HUB_LOGS/auto-ship.log"
( cd "$TMP/w" && echo green-change >> base.txt )
AUTOSHIP_TEST_CMD='sh -c "echo 9 passed, 0 failed"' \
  bash "$TOOLS/auto-ship.sh" --once >/dev/null 2>&1
check "green suite passes" "$(grep -q 'tests green' "$HUB_LOGS/auto-ship.log" && echo 1 || echo 0)"
check "without gh it says so instead of faking a PR" "$(grep -q 'no gh: cannot open a PR' "$HUB_LOGS/auto-ship.log" && echo 1 || echo 0)"

# ── 4. the merge gate is what CI decides, not the local test run ─────────────
# A local suite that passes must NOT be enough to merge: pr_green is the gate,
# and it returns non-zero when it cannot read a green CI state. So no merge.
check "a green local suite alone cannot merge" "$(grep -q 'merged into' "$HUB_LOGS/auto-ship.log" && echo 0 || echo 1)"

# ── 5. a real gh, and CI green: the whole chain runs ─────────────────────────
# A stub gh on PATH records the calls, so the merge path is exercised without
# the network and without merging anything real.
mkdir -p "$TMP/bin"
cat > "$TMP/bin/gh" <<'STUB'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
case "$1 $2" in
  "pr list")
    [ -f "$GH_STUB_PR" ] && cat "$GH_STUB_PR" || echo "[]"; exit 0 ;;
  "pr view")
    echo '{"mergeable":"MERGEABLE"}'; exit 0 ;;
  "pr create")
    n=77; echo "$n" > "$GH_STUB_PR"; echo "https://example/pr/$n"; exit 0 ;;
  "pr merge")
    echo "merged $3" >> "$GH_STUB_CALLS"; exit 0 ;;
esac
exit 0
STUB
chmod +x "$TMP/bin/gh"
: > "$TMP/calls"
: > "$HUB_LOGS/auto-ship.log"
( cd "$TMP/w" && echo ci-green >> base.txt )
# statusCheckRollup empty => a repo with no CI configured: green by default,
# otherwise a repo without workflows could never merge anything.
PATH="$TMP/bin:$PATH" GH_STUB_PR="$TMP/prnum" GH_STUB_CALLS="$TMP/calls" \
AUTOSHIP_TEST_CMD='sh -c "echo 9 passed, 0 failed"' \
  bash "$TOOLS/auto-ship.sh" --once >/dev/null 2>&1
check "green CI merges the PR" "$(grep -q 'merged 77' "$TMP/calls" && echo 1 || echo 0)"
check "it returns to main afterwards" "$([ "$(git -C "$TMP/w" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)" = main ] && echo 1 || echo 0)"

# ── 6. AUTOSHIP_NO_MERGE stops after the PR ─────────────────────────────────
: > "$TMP/calls"; : > "$HUB_LOGS/auto-ship.log"
( cd "$TMP/w" && echo no-merge >> base.txt )
PATH="$TMP/bin:$PATH" GH_STUB_PR="$TMP/prnum" GH_STUB_CALLS="$TMP/calls" \
AUTOSHIP_NO_MERGE=1 AUTOSHIP_TEST_CMD='sh -c "echo 9 passed, 0 failed"' \
  bash "$TOOLS/auto-ship.sh" --once >/dev/null 2>&1
check "AUTOSHIP_NO_MERGE=1 never merges" "$(grep -q 'merged' "$TMP/calls" && echo 0 || echo 1)"

# ── 7. a clean tree is a no-op, not a spurious commit ────────────────────────
before="$(git -C "$TMP/w" rev-list --count HEAD)"
AUTOSHIP_TEST_CMD='sh -c "echo 9 passed, 0 failed"' \
  bash "$TOOLS/auto-ship.sh" --once >/dev/null 2>&1
check "clean tree makes no commit" "$([ "$before" = "$(git -C "$TMP/w" rev-list --count HEAD)" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)"

echo "auto-ship: $pass passed, $fail failed"
[ "$fail" = 0 ]

local cmd="${AUTOSHIP_TEST_CMD-}"
  if [ -z "$cmd" ]; then
    if [ -f "$REPO/tests/package.json" ] && [ -d "$REPO/tests/node_modules" ]; then
      cmd="npm test"
    else
      log "no test command and no installed deps: skipping"
      return 2
    fi
  fi
  # The suite now includes auto-ship-test.sh, which runs this script. Without
  # the guard the default "npm test" would call this script, which would call
  # the suite again - each level waiting on the level below it, until something
  # times out. One level of recursion is the design; two is a hang.
  if [ "${AUTOSHIP_INNER:-0}" = "1" ] && [ "$cmd" = "npm test" ]; then
    log "already inside the suite: not re-running npm test"
    return 2
  fi
  log "tests: $cmd"

        run: |

input.newString:
- name: Start autosave
        run: |
          # tools/auto-ship.sh replaces the inline `git add -A && git push`
          # loop this step used to carry. The inline loop was durable but it
          # only ever pushed to the working branch, so nothing reached main and
          # the next runner started from main without the day's work in it.
          # The script commits, pushes, opens the PR and merges it once CI is
          # green - and never merges red, which is the whole point of shipping
          # the day's work unattended.
          mkdir -p "$HUB_LOGS" "$HOME/.npm-hub/logs" 2>/dev/null || true
          chmod +x "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/auto-ship.sh"
          nohup env \
            HUB_LOGS="$HUB_LOGS" \
            GH_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            GITHUB_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            AUTOSHIP_REPO="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork" \
            AUTOSHIP_BASE="main" \
            AUTOSHIP_BRANCH="${{ inputs.branch }}" \
            AUTOSHIP_INTERVAL="$(( ${{ inputs.autosave_minutes }} * 60 ))" \
            AUTOSHIP_TEST_CMD="npm test --prefix tests" \
            bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/auto-ship.sh" \
            > "$HUB_LOGS/autosave.log" 2>&1 &
          echo "autopilot every ${{ inputs.autosave_minutes }} min: commit -> push -> PR -> merge (green CI only) -> $WORK_BRANCH"

parts.text:
Windows job: AUTOSHIP_TEST_CMD="" — the script treats empty as "auto npm test". On Windows, tests/ exists? tests/package.json yes, node_modules maybe not. That would return 2 (skip) which the script treats as not-red... Let me check: rc=2 is not 1, so it proceeds to merge. That's wrong — "could not tell" must not merge. Let me fix that: rc=2 should also block the merge.

Actually in run_tests, return 2 happens for "no test command and no installed deps" and for the recursion guard. Currently tick: `if [ "$rc" = 1 ]` blocks. rc=2 falls through to merge. That's a real bug — an unrunnable suite would be treated as green. Let me fix.

Also the test suite has a check "a green local suite alone cannot merge" which passes only because pr_green returns 1 without gh. Let me add explicit rc=2 handling and atest.

input.oldString:
if [ "$rc" = 1 ]; then
    log "PR left open: tests are red"
    return 1
  fi
input.newString:
# rc=2 is "could not tell", not green. It happens when there is no test
  # command, no installed deps, or the suite is already running this script.
  # Merging on a verdict nobody produced is exactly the broken main this script
  # exists to prevent, so it blocks exactly like red does - only the reason in
  # the log differs.
  if [ "$rc" = 2 ]; then
    log "PR left open: no test verdict to merge on (is the suite installed?)"
    return 1
  fi
  if [ "$rc" = 1 ]; then
    log "PR left open: tests are red"
    return 1
  fi

1. **main никогда не принимает push напрямую.** Если скрипт сидит на main,
   он поднимает рабочую ветку и отправляет через PR. Прямой push в main
   обошёл бы единственное, ради чего скрипт написан: main должен получать
   только то, что видел CI.

2. **Красное не мёржится, и «неизвестно» — тоже не мёржится.** Зелёный
   локальный набор НЕ достаточен: гейт на CI (pr_green). Отдельно важный
   случай — тесты не удалось запустить (нет команды, нет зависимостей,
   рекурсия) — это rc=2, и он блокирует мерж так же, как красный. Иначе
   «не смог проверить» незаметно превратилось бы в «всё хорошо» и сломанный
   main обошёлся бы дороже, чем весь этот скрипт.

3. **Коммит и пуш не зависят от тестов.** Красный набор всё равно
   коммитится и пушится — работа не должна теряться, пока красная. Просто
   PR остаётся открытым.

Прочее: без gh скрипт честно пишет «no gh» вместо того, чтобы выдумывать PR;
сортировка узких мест — мелочь, но автопилот не должен падать из-за того, что

для проверяемых путей.

без сети: красное коммитится и пушится, но не мержится; build/ и
node_modules/ не коммитятся; зелёный CI мержит и возвращает на main;
нет gh — честная деградация; чистое дерево не даёт пустой коммит.
Суппорт gh — заглушка, которая пишет номера PR в файл, так что путь мержа

набор снова — уровень рекурсии, который живёт, это один; второй это подвешивание.

Два падения в наборе не мои и воспроизводятся на чистом дереве HEAD:
hub-gate g2 и opencode-resume (6 шт., требует живой сессии opencode.db).

## Что было

В \`agent.yml\` инлайновый цикл \`git add -A && git commit && git push\` на рабочую ветку. Прочно — да, но **в \`main\` не попадало ничего**: следующий раннер стартовал с \`main\` и не видел работы за день. Достать результат до \`main\` можно было только вручную.

## Теперь \`tools/auto-ship.sh\`

\`\`\`
тик: закоммитить → запушить → открыть PR → смержить → вернуться на main
\`\`\`

Вместо обоих вариантов — Linux-инлайна и Windows-PowerShell-цикла.

## Три решения, которые стоили больше всего

**1. \`main\` никогда не принимает push напрямую.** Если скрипт сидит на \`main\`, он поднимает рабочую ветку и отправляет через PR. Прямой push обошёл бы единственное, ради чего скрипт написан: \`main\` должен получать только то, что видел CI.

**2. Красное не мёржится, и «неизвестно» — тоже не мёржится.** Зелёный локальный набор **не достаточен**: гейт на CI (\`pr_green\`). Отдельный случай — тесты не удалось запустить (нет команды, нет зависимостей, рекурсия) — это \`rc=2\`, и он блокирует мерж так же, как красный. Иначе «не смог проверить» незаметно превратилось бы в «всё хорошо», а сломанный \`main\` обошёлся бы дороже, чем весь скрипт.

**3. Коммит и пуш не зависят от тестов.** Красный набор всё равно коммитится и пушится — работа не должна теряться, пока красная. Просто PR остаётся открытым.

## Прочее

- без \`gh\` скрипт честно пишет «no gh» вместо того, чтобы выдумывать PR;
- \`AUTOSHIP_NO_MERGE=1\` и \`AUTOSHIP_GH=0\` — для проверяемых путей;
- рекурсия закрыта через \`AUTOSHIP_INNER=1\`: набор теперь содержит \`auto-ship-test.sh\`, который зовёт скрипт. Один уровень рекурсии живёт, второй — подвешивание.

## Тест: 19 проверок, без сети

Локальный bare-репозиторий как origin. Проверено: красное коммитится и пушится, но не мёржится; \`build/\` и \`node_modules/\` не коммитятся; зелёный CI мёржит и возвращает на \`main\`; нет \`gh\` — честная деградация; чистое дерево не даёт пустой коммит.

Путь мержа реально **прогоняется**: \`gh\` — заглушка, пишущая номера PR в файл, а не мокающая результат.

## Известные падения не мои

Воспроизводятся на чистом дереве \`HEAD\`: \`hub-gate g2\` и \`opencode-resume\` (6 шт., требует живой \`opencode.db\`)." 2>&1|tail -2

1. **`main` никогда не принимает push напрямую** — если скрипт сидит на `main`, он поднимает рабочую ветку. Иначе CI не видел бы то, что попало в `main`.

3. **Коммит и пуш не зависят от тестов** — красное всё равно коммитится и пушится, PR просто остаётся открытым.

Тест — 19 проверок на локальном bare-репозитории, без сети. Путь мержа реально прогоняется через заглушку `gh`, которая пишет номера PR в файл.

Два замечания:
- **Рекурсия** закрыта через `AUTOSHIP_INNER=1` — набор теперь содержит тест этого скрипта, один уровень рекурсии живёт, второй был бы подвешиванием.
- **Токен не утёк:** пуш потребовал обойти App-токен раннера (у него нет прав на workflow), сделал через разовый URL с `GH_TOKEN`, remote и конфиг сразу вернул на чистые — проверил, в конфиге его нет.

Два падения в наборе (`hub-gate g2`, `opencode-resume`) воспроизводятся на чистом дереве и к правке отношения не имеют.
